description: This file defines the InOperator class, which is a filter operator used in the SuiteCRM JSON API v1 to handle 'in' comparison operations within filters. It provides methods to generate corresponding filter tags and SQL operators, validate operands, and format operand lists for SQL queries.

classes.name: InOperator
classes.description: A filter operator class representing the 'in' comparison in API filters, capable of providing SQL and API filter representations, validating operands, and formatting operand lists for SQL statements.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter tag string for 'in' operator used in API filters.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL keyword 'IN' associated with this operator.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the provided operator is a string and potentially other validation logic from parent.

methods.name: totalOperands
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of operands supported, which is 255.

methods.name: toSqlOperands
methods.description: Formats an array of operands into a parenthesized string suitable for SQL queries.
